title: Durable Artifact Slug
description: The shared identifier shape for a durable, persisted artifact document (a flow-spec or flow-review artifact) — lowercase, hyphen-separated, matching both the filename (without extension) and the directory it lives under. This file defines the value domain ONLY; the naming/placement SEMANTICS live in flow-spec / flow-review. Referenced by co-located schemas via {"$ref": "artifact-slug.schema.json"}.
